name: zoomable-image-lightbox
title: Zoomable Image Lightbox
description: A media preview container that transitions into an enlarged lightbox overlay focusing detail on click.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Click Zoom Lightbox Transition: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
